title: Gujarat's Semiconductor Push: Micron Sanand Live, Dholera Fab Advancing
shortDescription: PM Modi inaugurated Micron's Sanand chip-assembly plant in February 2026; Tata-PSMC's Dholera fab crossed 50% construction with trial production targeted for late 2026.
genZNote: Micron is ONLINE, Dholera is STILL BUILDING — that ongoing/completed split is exactly the kind of exam trap this whole ISRO-style status label exists for.

sections.heading: What Happened
sections.body: On 28 February 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Micron Technology's Assembly, Test, Marking and Packaging (ATMP) semiconductor facility in Sanand, Gujarat — the first operational plant of India's current semiconductor mission cycle. Meanwhile, the larger Tata Electronics–PSMC semiconductor fabrication (fab) plant at Dholera, Gujarat reached roughly 50% construction by mid-2026, with trial production targeted for late 2026.

sections.heading: Key Facts
bullets: Micron's Sanand ATMP plant: inaugurated 28 Feb 2026 by PM Modi — COMPLETED and operational.
A second Sanand-area semiconductor unit commenced operations 31 March 2026; Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said four plants would be ready by 2026.
Tata Electronics–PSMC Dholera fab: ~₹91,000 crore project, 50,000 wafers/month capacity, ONGOING — around 50% complete as of mid-2026, trial production targeted late 2026.
Dholera Special Investment Region received SEZ notification on 9 April 2026.
In May 2026, two more units were approved: Crystal Matrix Limited (Dholera, Mini/Micro-LED & GaN) and Suchi Semicon (Surat, OSAT) — combined ₹3,936 crore, ~2,230 jobs.
Union Budget 2026-27 allocated ₹8,000 crore to the semiconductor mission and announced 'ISM 2.0' for semiconductor equipment and materials manufacturing.

sections.heading: Why It Matters
sections.body: This directly links Gujarat's economic current affairs to the national India Semiconductor Mission and the Union Budget 2026-27 — a good example of a state-level fact and a national-level fact reinforcing each other in an exam question.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Micron's Sanand ATMP plant is operational (Feb 2026); the larger Tata-PSMC Dholera fab is still under construction, targeting trial production by late 2026.
keyFacts: Micron Sanand ATMP — inaugurated 28 Feb 2026, COMPLETED.
Tata-PSMC Dholera fab — ONGOING, ~50% complete mid-2026, ~₹91,000 crore.
Dholera SIR got SEZ notification on 9 April 2026.
Union Budget 2026-27: ₹8,000 crore to the semiconductor mission; ISM 2.0 announced.
commonConfusion: Micron's Sanand plant does ATMP (assembly/testing/packaging), NOT full chip fabrication — the actual fab is the separate, still-under-construction Tata-PSMC Dholera plant.

highYieldFacts: Micron Sanand = ATMP, operational since Feb 2026. Tata-PSMC Dholera = fab, still under construction in 2026.
commonTraps: Assuming India's first semiconductor FAB (not just an assembly/testing plant) was already operational in 2026 — the Dholera fab was still under construction.
mustRemember: ATMP ≠ fab: Sanand does the former (done), Dholera does the latter (ongoing).
